# system.isSensorDiscoverActive

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.4</span></div>

Return if the sensor discover is active.

```lua
system.isSensorDiscoverActive()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

Boolean

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
print(system.isSensorDiscoverActive())
end
```
